name: AMD Radeon Instinct MI60 product page (archived 2018-11-22)
notes: Archived AMD product page for the GCN5.1 MI60. Only source found for its numbers; the live URL 404s. Key features list gives 64 CUs / 4096 SPs, 29.5 TFLOPS FP16, 14.7 TFLOPS FP32, 7.4 TFLOPS FP64, 58.9 TOPS INT8, 32 GB HBM2, 4096-bit, 1024 GB/s, 300W, 1800 MHz peak engine clock.
